zh-CN.title: 足迹卡片补齐猫咪特效
items: 足迹地图消息现在支持 Niko 的太空漫步与 Fufu 的奔跑特效
Niko 改为真实气泡内元素，不再依赖外层结构判断
足迹卡片仅为猫咪特效开放边缘空间，卡片圆角保持不变

en.title: Cat effects for travel-map cards
items: Travel-map messages now support Niko's moonwalk and Fufu's running effect
Niko now renders as a real bubble child instead of relying on outer structure detection
Only the cat-effect edge is allowed outside the card while its rounded surface remains intact
